summary: Sandbach United fell to a narrow 3-2 defeat against Foley Meir in a frustrating encounter where they created plenty of chances but couldn't capitalize on them. Saul Shotton grabbed a late goal with a fine far post volley to give the team hope, but it proved too little too late as they were undone by soft free kicks and poor marking in the first half. The Bach will be looking to bounce back when they face Stafford Town on Saturday.
